summary:
Implementation plan for the Real-Time File-Watcher & Automated Build Hook. 
Watches full repository files (excluding dist, node_modules, and git directories), executes build and diagnostic verification immediately on save, parses TypeScript and Vite compiler output in real-time, and streams live test results, build logs, and assertion states via the existing WebSocket channel directly into the Lit 3.2 Cockpit Test Runner tab.
